legacy.why: Your group character. Thrill of Adventure does nothing in dungeons and little in a group (the killing blows are shared), so it is left out. Well Rested first: you are logged out between group nights, so your rested bar fills and caps, and rested experience doubles kill experience, dungeon kills included; it is also the price of Talented. Talented gives your next five tank talents five levels early (more threat and survival in every dungeon until 55). Then Gourmand (one meal lasts a whole dungeon), The Quick and the Dead (a faster corpse run and free heals and blessings after a wipe) and Reinforce (tanks die most). At 60, respec for the endgame (user decision 2026-11-10).
